name: omnigami-end-card
description: End card for a launch video: your mark, name, address, the one action (a line to type or your own button) and a tagline, landing on the beat and held to the last frame. 4 seconds, square, wide and tall, with sound. Use when the user asks for an end card, outro, closing frame, call to action or logo lockup for a launch video, teaser, demo or ad.
